engineNote: Fresh Higgsfield pipeline. The legacy Runway gen4_image @tag / 3-reference-cap rules and the Kling CFG/MICRO-MOVE block are NOT inherited. Parameters below are re-derived from Higgsfield's Soul (text-to-image) and Cinema Studio / DoP (image-to-video) APIs.

image.resolutionNote: Project target is 1080x1920 vertical 9:16. Higgsfield Soul does not offer 1080x1920 directly; 1152x2048 is the exact 9:16 enum value and is downscaled to 1080x1920 on export.
image.enhancePromptNote: Disabled. We control prompt wording exactly (Shared DNA + inline negatives); auto-enhance drifts identity and reintroduces stripped genre words.

identityLock.note: One reference per character. Preferred path: pre-create a Higgsfield custom reference (Soul character) per character from its canonical _reference.png and store the returned UUID in characters/registry.json (refs.higgsfieldCustomReferenceId). Until trained, pass the Drive-exported public image URL via image_reference_image_url. Higgsfield has NO multi-tag / @tag mechanism — multi-character scenes are composed sequentially or via a single combined reference (see enzo_maria, arun_priya).

style.note: soul_style_id null = general photoreal style. Brand colour grade is carried by the Shared DNA prompt language in characters/shared.md, not a Soul style preset. style_strength kept low so the prompt-described grade dominates.

image.negativesNote: Higgsfield Soul has NO negative-prompt field. The Shared Negatives and Bella-specific negatives in characters/shared.md MUST be folded into the prompt body as a trailing 'ABSOLUTELY NO ...' clause.

video.modelNote: dop-preview default for storyboard-approved renders; dop-turbo for fast internal previews; dop-lite for cheapest drafts.
video.endFrameNote: Cinema Studio supports a start frame plus an OPTIONAL end frame. Per content item we produce start.png + end.png keyframes; both are passed so motion is bounded between approved frames.
video.motionStrengthNote: Higgsfield motion_strength (0-1, API default 0.8) replaces the legacy Kling CFG/MICRO-MOVE motion guidance. 0.55 = controlled documentary handheld feel.
video.ciaoMotionNote: Replaces the old 'CFG 0.3 for Ciao stillness' rule — low motion_strength keeps the Italian Greyhound still and identity-stable.

klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Runway @tag face-crop reference: Higgsfield custom_reference_id (trained Soul character) OR image_reference_image_url (single ref). No @tag.
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Runway 3-reference cap: N/A — one custom reference per generation; multi-character handled sequentially / combined refs.
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Runway 1000-char prompt cap: Not applicable to Higgsfield Soul; still keep prompts tight and front-load identity + wardrobe + camera-address clause.
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Kling MICRO-MOVE: video.motion_strength low band (0.3-0.55) + a low-motion motion_id
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Negative prompt block: No native field — inline 'ABSOLUTELY NO ...' clause appended to the Higgsfield prompt body

approvalGate.rule: Per content item: generate script + scene prompts + still keyframe(s) (start.png/end.png). The user manually approves the storyboard. Video generation (any dop/Cinema Studio call) is BLOCKED until the content item's status is 'storyboard_approved'. Nothing spends video-generation budget without explicit manual approval.

frameConventions.restaurantNameRule: Restaurant name NEVER appears in the visual. Strip genre words (trattoria, restaurant, Italian, osteria, and the specific restaurant name) from image prompts; carry restaurant identity in the script/VO only.
frameConventions.antiExteriorClause: ABSOLUTELY NO exterior view, NO street, NO sky, NO shop-fronts, NO painted signage, NO neon, NO restaurant name on any wall.
